title: 이사 도와줄 수 있어요? 부탁하고 거절하기
objective: Ask a friend for a favor, say no politely, and add a reason with -고요.
summary: One classmate asks for help with moving, and the other politely says no.
setting: A university classroom right after class. Minsu and Rina are classmates who use polite 해요 speech with each other.

task.title: Ask and refuse politely
task.line: Read the dialogue and word list again, then choose, fill in, or write your answers in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: Please help me with my homework.

words.meaning: a softener that makes a request polite, like 'please'
words.exampleMeaning: Could you open the window, please?

words.meaning: I'm sorry (said first, before you say no)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm sorry. I don't have time today.

words.meaning: it's a bit hard for me (a soft way to say no)
words.exampleMeaning: Tomorrow doesn't really work for me.

words.meaning: that's okay, don't worry (a reply when someone says no)

words.exampleMeaning: Let's meet again some other time.

words.meaning: an ending that adds one more reason or detail to what you just said ('and also ...')
words.exampleMeaning: I'm busy today. And I'm a bit tired, too.

dialogue.meaning: Rina, I have a favor to ask you.

dialogue.korean: 저 토요일에 이사해요. 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I'm moving on Saturday. Could you help me?

dialogue.korean: 아, 미안해요. 토요일은 좀 어려워요. 아르바이트가 있어요. 저녁에는 약속도 있고요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I'm sorry. Saturday is a bit hard for me. I have my part-time job. And I have plans in the evening, too.

dialogue.korean: 일요일은 어때요? 일요일은 시간이 있어요. 아르바이트도 없고요.
dialogue.meaning: How about Sunday? I'm free on Sunday. And I don't have work that day.

exercises: Choose the polite refusal: ⓐ 네, 좋아요. ⓑ 미안해요. 오늘은 약속이 있어요. ⓒ 고마워요.
Add one more reason with -고요: ① 오늘은 못 가요. 숙제가 ____ (많다) ② 내일은 못 만나요. 머리도 ____ (아프다)

Fill in the blank with an expression from the word list. B invited A to lunch, and A says no. B is not upset and tells A it is okay. Choose from 괜찮아요 / 좀 어려워요 / 도와주다. A: 미안해요. 오늘은 못 가요. B: ____. 다음에 같이 먹어요.
Answer in Korean: Your friend says, "금요일에 이사해요. 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?" Say no politely and give two reasons. Use -고요 for the second reason.
answers: Sample answer: 미안해요. 금요일은 좀 어려워요. 수업이 있어요. 아르바이트도 있고요. (Any polite refusal with 미안해요 and a second reason ending in -고요 is correct.)
